features: What's New & Help bar: The old always-visible sidebar (What's New panel + Help & Resources card) is now a single collapsible bar at the top of the dashboard, minimized by default and auto-expanding once when there's something new to see.
Fixed the What's New & Help toggle being unclear -- it's now a proper outlined button with explicit Show/Hide text instead of a bare chevron.
Fixed What's New and Help & Resources not actually sitting side by side on wider screens once expanded.
Split Reservations View: The dashboard now shows Registered Subdomains and Custom Domains as two separate tables instead of one interleaved list.
MFA Setup Prompt: If your administrator requires multi-factor authentication, you'll now see a dedicated setup screen the moment it's needed, instead of the dashboard just failing to load.
Reliability: lfr-tunnel-ops deploy can now recover a scheduled-off edge automatically instead of failing outright.
Fixed a gap where Linux ARM64 release binaries weren't individually signature-verified.
Security Fix: Patched a vulnerability in the admin portal's dependencies (react-router-dom, GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2).
Permanent Vanity Domains: Custom vanity domains no longer get torn down when you disconnect -- they stick around until you remove them.
Separate Custom Domain Quota: Custom domains now draw from their own quota, independent of subdomain reservations.
Vanity Domain Admin Page: New admin console page showing per-stage vanity domain provisioning status, with retry/remove actions.
Portal v1 -> v2 Link: The classic portal login page now links directly to the new v2 portal.
CLI Redraw Fix: Fixed leftover characters lingering in the terminal UI during live redraws.
Published Documentation Site: lfr-tunnel's docs are now published as a browsable site (MkDocs + GitHub Pages), in addition to the raw markdown in the repo.
Favicon Fix: Replaced the browser tab icon across the portal with the correct logo (was a mismatched placeholder image).
